corridor_notes: This PID is the first phase (Jintang-Tong'an section) of the wider Jintang-Pingqiao Gas Pipeline (金堂—平桥输气管道工程, total 59.85km), which transports tight/dense gas from the Tianfu Gas Field's Jianyang block toward Chengdu. Per Sichuan Economic Daily (scjjrb.cn, 2026-05-18) and a matching Sina Finance report (2026-05-15), the Jintang-Tong'an section was formally commissioned on 2026-05-12, following nitrogen displacement and pressure-up; it includes three valve stations along the route (五通/Wutong, 丽阳/Liyang, 锦绣/Jinxiu) and terminates at the newly built Tong'an gas transmission station (同安输气站). A separate downstream section, Tong'an-to-Chengdu, was commissioned earlier (2026-03-15 per sc.sina.cn) feeding into the Chengdu Transmission Station (design pressure 4.0MPa, 4 billion m3/yr capacity) -- confirming 'Tong'an' here is a distinct waypoint/station short of Chengdu proper, not the pipeline's final destination. Tong'an itself resolves to Tong'an Subdistrict (同安街道) in Longquanyi District, Chengdu -- NOT a place in Jintang County itself, despite the segment being named 'Jintang-Tong'an'.
researcher_notes: GEM's StartLocation 'Jintang' and EndLocation 'Tong'an' are both corroborated, but the specific Jintang-side originating station name (e.g. a 'Jintang first station') was not found in the sources reviewed -- start point is geocoded at county level only. Note the corridor runs Jianyang block (gas source, not part of this PID) -> Jintang -> Tong'an (Longquanyi District, Chengdu) -> Chengdu Station (separate downstream PID/section, per the Tong'an-Pingqiao note already in ResearcherNotes).
blockers: No source names a specific Jintang-side station (only the county-level place 'Jintang' is confirmed), so the start coordinate is a county centroid rather than a station-level point.
